hero.desc: Dance and movement as tools for expression and well-being. Art as a path to social transformation.

seq1.p1: There are places that do not exist on the map.

seq2.p1: is a social organization born to build these places. Spaces where dance is not only performance, but above all is presence. Where movement is more than exercise or stretching, it is listening and expression. Where art is not an end, but the beginning of an encounter.
seq2.p2: The encounter with oneself and the encounter that happens when people breathe and move at the same rhythm.
seq2.p3: Change begins in the skin, when a person rediscovers their own strength, their creativity, their own voice. And when this happens in a group, a path opens up for
seq2.p6: creates the conditions for people to meet.

card1.desc: Every body carries a dance it hasn't yet dared to step into. These workshops are the space where movement, presence and expression bring it to light.

card2.desc: Conscious movement practices that broaden perception, stimulate body reorganization and transform the way we inhabit the body.

card3.desc: Community projects that cross streets and neighborhoods, weaving ties, creating bonds and transforming.

1.title: Expression
1.desc: The body holds what words cannot express. In the workshops, movement becomes a language and creates a space where rhythm, presence and improvisation set free what has been held back.

2.title: Well-being
2.desc: Listening to the body is a political act. Conscious movement practices expand perception, reorganize physical patterns and return to people the authorship over themselves.

3.title: Creation
3.desc: Movement is raw material. From dance choreography is born, from silence the gesture is born, from the encounter the work is born. Art is what happens when the body has the freedom to express itself.

4.title: Transformation
4.desc: When people move together, something changes. Dance crosses walls, creates bonds and opens space for a transformation that begins in the body and reverberates on the street, in the neighborhood, in the city.

action.desc: Find a workshop, a class, your place. The body knows the way, just start.
action.btn2: I want to support the project

footer.desc: Transforming lives through movement and dance. A project focused on expression and social well-being.

hero.subtitle: A model for universal access to culture and movement. Premium workshops, free for residents of Gamle Oslo — sustained by multiple funding sources.

context.title: Why Gamle Oslo?
context.p1: Gamle Oslo is a neighbourhood of contrasts — diversity, history and cultural richness coexist with inequalities in access to quality services and activities. This is exactly the context that calls us to act.
context.p2: Dance2Dance is born in this territory with a clear mission: that dance, movement and well-being should not be a privilege for those who can pay. Every workshop we develop carries the same quality, the same care and the same intention — regardless of who is in the room.
context.quote: The same product. The same quality. The same value. For everyone.

value.kicker: The value of what we offer
value.title: Free does not mean without value.
value.subtitle: Those who receive it for free receive exactly the same as those who pay. We make the real price visible because perceived value matters — for supporters and participants alike.

paid.label: External participants
paid.desc: Residents from outside Gamle Oslo participate at the regular rate, with access to the same premium quality experience.

free.label: Gamle Oslo residents
free.desc: Local residents have guaranteed, free access to all workshops. No waiting lists, no distinction, no lesser quality.

value.insight: “Free access with price transparency creates dignity. The person is not receiving charity — they are receiving the opportunity to be part of something with real value.”

model.title: An ecosystem of support.
model.intro: Dance2Dance was designed not to rely on a single source. Our sustainability comes from the strategic combination of multiple pillars — each essential, none sufficient alone.

pillar1.title: Paying participants
pillar1.desc: Those who come from outside Gamle Oslo pay the real value of the workshop. This revenue directly contributes to enabling free access for local residents.

pillar2.title: Companies & sponsors
pillar2.desc: Private companies wishing to associate their brand with real social impact and quality culture find in Dance2Dance a purposeful and visible partner.

pillar3.title: Public funds & municipality
pillar3.desc: The project aligns with public policies on cultural and community inclusion, making it eligible for support from cultural funds and the City of Oslo.

pillar4.title: Individual donors
pillar4.desc: People who believe in the power of art as social transformation can support directly, becoming part of the story from the very beginning.

model.summary: The diversification of revenue sources is intentional: it ensures the project does not depend on any single entity, making it more resilient and scalable over time.

partners.title: Partners who build together.
partners.desc: Dance2Dance does not act alone. We work in network with organisations that share the conviction that art transforms and that access to culture is a right.

cta.title: Support what is still being born.

context.p2: Backed by the technical expertise of Porto Alegre Cia de Dança, Dance2Dance offers an aesthetic and transformative experience. Knowledge and practices developed over years of artistic experience now reach the local community through dance workshops, body awareness practices, and social integration experiences.
context.quote: Excellence is not a privilege. It is an opportunity.

free.label: Local Community

be-the-dance.title: Be the Dance
be-the-dance.subtitle: Descubra a dança que existe em você.
be-the-dance.description: Filosofia e conceito do Be the Dance...

philosophy.title: BE THE DANCE
content: é um programa de quatro workshops de dança.
Foi desenhado para você explorar o movimento como caminho de presença, expressão e autoconhecimento, despertando algo essencial e único que já existe em você: sua própria dança.

philosophy.title: BE THE DANCE É PARA TODOS
content: A dança pode nascer no corpo de qualquer pessoa que se permita mover.
Não há exigências.
Basta sentir e permitir que o movimento se expresse.
Em qualquer idade ou condição física, é possível descobrir uma forma própria de dançar.

philosophy.title: ONDE ESTÁ A DANÇA?
content: Não está restrita a uma técnica, a um estilo pré-definido ou a um talento especial.
Ela existe em cada pessoa, como uma criatividade inerente pronta para ganhar forma por meio do corpo.

philosophy.title: COMO ACONTECE A DANÇA?
content: A dança nos acompanha há milênios, como ritual, celebração e expressão artística. Ainda que você não lembre, há no corpo uma memória de movimento, uma capacidade de sentir, criar e dançar.
Ao criar um diálogo sensível entre música e corpo, abrimos a possibilidade de explorar novos caminhos de movimento. Ir além do conhecido permite que novas formas de expressão possam emergir.
A dança acontece para além do controle e da busca por uma forma ideal. Quando nos permitimos estar presentes, uma expressão mais autêntica e única pode emergir do corpo.

philosophy.title: QUAIS OS BENEFÍCIOS?
content: • Favorecer o relaxamento profundo e contribuir para a redução do estresse.
• Ampliar a energia, a disponibilidade corporal e a fluidez dos movimentos.
• Reconhecer movimentos naturais e ampliar a consciência corporal, criando espaço para uma expressão mais autêntica.
• Desenvolver a atenção, despertando os sentidos e aprofundando a presença.
• Explorar a relação entre respiração e movimento, descobrindo novas formas de dançar com mais liberdade.
• Ampliar a percepção reconhecendo as diferentes partes do corpo e as relações entre elas.

philosophy.title: BE THE DANCE
content: Workshops que integram a consciência do movimento com práticas de dança e meditação, para você descobrir e expressar a dança que já existe em você.

be-water.title: Be Water
be-water.fullDescription:
Surrendering to movement is finding the flow.
When we stop trying to direct every gesture, the body naturally finds new paths. Movement becomes freer and more organic, guided by listening and sensation.
In this workshop, we explore flowing as a possibility of expression. An invitation to experience movement without resistance, trust the body, and allow one action to naturally lead to the next.
Like water, which finds its way without needing to fight against it, we learn to accompany movement instead of controlling it.
Be Water is an experience of surrender. A space to let the body follow its own flow and discover the dance that emerges when we simply let go.
be-water.closingQuote:
Be Water, My Friend.
Empty your mind.
Be formless, shapeless, like water.
You put water into a cup, it becomes the cup.
You put water into a bottle, it becomes the bottle.
You put it into a teapot, it becomes the teapot.
Now water can flow or it can crash.
Be water, my friend.

be-balance.title: Be Balance
be-balance.fullDescription:
Finding balance is learning to listen to the body.
Balance is not static. It is in constant movement, between support and impulse, stability and change, presence and action.
In this workshop, we explore this dynamic relationship and the different ways to find stability within movement. An invitation to discover how strength, lightness, and balance can coexist and create new possibilities.
The body has its own intelligence. When we learn to listen to it, we can trust its choices and allow it to find its own balance.
be-balance.closingQuote: Balance is not the absence of movement, but the perfect harmony between the forces that move us.

be-total.title: Be Total
be-total.fullDescription:
To dance is to be whole. It is holding nothing back.
Without protecting yourself, without hesitating, without saving energy. When we allow ourselves to be fully in what we do, the body finds the freedom to express itself with spontaneity and truth.
In this workshop, we explore total surrender to the moment. An invitation to trust the impulse, commit fully to each gesture, and let the body express itself without reservation.
It is not about doing more, but about being completely present in what we do. About putting everything into the movement and allowing each gesture to be lived entirely.
Be Total is an experience of surrender and expression. A space to be totally present, without saving energy, and discover what happens when we allow ourselves to dance without reservation.
be-total.closingQuote:
DANCE, my heart.
Dance today with joy.

be-stillness.title: Be Stillness
be-stillness.fullDescription:
In stillness, the body begins to speak.
Between one thought and another, between one breath and the next, there is silence. It is in this gap that we can listen to the subtlest sensations of the body.
In this workshop, we explore pausing and listening as an essential part of movement. An invitation to slow down and feel the body, letting what is revealed emerge when there is no need to always be in motion.
Stillness is not the absence of movement. It is above all possibility.
Be Stillness is an experience of listening. A space to be present, find silence within movement, and allow the dance to reveal itself from there.

be-the-dance-pro.title: BE THE DANCE PRO
be-the-dance-pro.fullDescription:
You are already a dancer. Now, be the dance.

Technique is the instrument through which the dancer expresses their art. But there is something beyond it: a presence, a quality of surrender, a way of being in the movement that makes some dancers capable of capturing our attention and touching us in a unique way.
What is presence?

In this workshop, we investigate this “something more”. An invitation to go beyond execution, the intellect, and the mind that observes and controls, and dive into an experience of presence, awareness, and surrender.

Through practices of somatic education, meditation, guided improvisation, and other tools for movement exploration, we create space to listen to the body, expand perception, and discover new possibilities of being on stage.

More than adding new tools to technique, Be The Dance Pro proposes a journey inward. An investigation into what happens when we stop merely doing the dance and allow it to happen through us.
What is charisma?

​
Be The Dance Pro is an experience of presence and totality. A space to deepen the relationship between body, mind, and movement and discover what makes each dancer unique.

A quest to lose oneself in the dance to find that place where dancer and dance cease to be two different things.

The moment the dancer is the dance itself.

be-the-dance-day.title: BE THE DANCE DAY
be-the-dance-day.fullDescription:
Dancing is also encountering the other.

There is music that makes us travel, rhythms that awaken the body, and movements that bring us closer, even when we don't speak the same language.

Be The Dance Day is an open gathering for everyone to dance, have fun, and share the experience of movement to the sounds of different music and cultures.

Throughout the gathering, we are invited to experience different rhythms, ways of dancing, and ways of relating to music and those around us. No dance experience is necessary, no right or wrong steps, just the curiosity to experiment and the freedom to let ourselves go.

More than learning a dance, it is an opportunity to experience dance as an encounter: with music, with the body, with different cultures, and with other people.

​
Be The Dance Day is a celebration of movement and diversity. A space to let the body participate, discover new rhythms, have fun, create connections, and simply dance.

Come as you are. Let's dance together.

biostretch.title: Biostretch
biostretch.subtitle: Four decades of research into movement.
biostretch.description: Biostretch é um sistema de exercícios...

philosophy.title: O QUE É O BIOSTRETCH?
content: Biostretch é um sistema de exercícios que promove a reconexão com o corpo por meio da consciência do movimento.

O método utiliza a atenção como sua principal ferramenta: um recurso simples, poderoso e acessível a todos. Ao direcioná-la para a experiência do movimento, ampliamos a percepção do corpo e abrimos espaço para novas possibilidades de organização corporal.

Inspirado em mais de quatro décadas de estudos em dança, Educação Somática e meditação, o método reconhece o corpo como um sistema inteligente, integrado e em constante transformação. Em vez de buscar desempenho ou correção, propõe uma investigação sutil da experiência corporal, na qual importa menos o que se faz e mais como se faz.
É dessa experiência de presença que nasce uma nova forma de perceber e habitar o corpo. Mas como essa transformação acontece na prática?

philosophy.title: COMO ATUA?
content: A prática do Biostretch convida você a desacelerar, relaxar o corpo e direcionar a atenção para movimentos simples e para as sensações que eles despertam.

Nessa exploração, torna-se possível reconhecer padrões de tensão, hábitos de movimento e formas de organização corporal que costumam permanecer fora da nossa percepção por operarem de forma automática e inconsciente. A aparente simplicidade da prática revela um trabalho profundo de escuta, percepção e reorganização.

Ao serem realizados de forma lenta, suave e sem esforço, os exercícios favorecem um estado de equilíbrio no sistema nervoso, responsável por coordenar a comunicação entre corpo e mente e regular as funções do organismo. Nesse estado, o corpo encontra espaço para liberar tensões, reorganizar-se e recuperar a fluidez natural do movimento.

Mais do que ensinar novos movimentos, o Biostretch fortalece a confiança na inteligência inata do corpo e convida a redescobrir o prazer de mover-se com liberdade, presença e consciência. O melhor é que essa experiência está ao alcance de qualquer pessoa.

philosophy.title: QUEM PODE PRATICAR?
content: O Biostretch pode ser praticado por pessoas de todas as idades e diferentes níveis de experiência, condicionamento físico ou mobilidade.

A prática respeita a individualidade de cada corpo. Não existe um movimento ideal a ser alcançado nem um padrão externo a ser seguido. Cada pessoa explora as sequências dentro de seus próprios limites e possibilidades, no seu próprio ritmo.

Em vez de adaptar o corpo a um modelo, o Biostretch valoriza aquilo que cada pessoa já possui: sua capacidade de perceber, aprender e encontrar caminhos mais confortáveis e funcionais para o movimento. Assim, a prática fortalece a autonomia, a confiança e o prazer de habitar o próprio corpo.
E o que essa prática pode transformar no dia a dia?

philosophy.title: QUAIS OS BENEFÍCIOS?
content: A prática regular do Biostretch contribui para aliviar tensões, ampliar a mobilidade, melhorar a postura e tornar os movimentos mais leves, coordenados e confortáveis. Com o tempo, o corpo recupera a fluidez e eficiência, tornando as atividades do dia a dia mais fáceis e prazerosas.

Ao favorecer o equilíbrio do sistema nervoso, a prática também ajuda a reduzir os efeitos do estresse, melhorar a qualidade da respiração e aliviar dores e desconfortos associados à tensão muscular, especialmente em regiões como pescoço, ombros e costas. Além disso, contribui para prevenir lesões relacionadas a padrões repetitivos e ao uso excessivo do corpo.
Com o tempo, essas mudanças se estendem para além da prática e passam a fazer parte da maneira como nos movemos, percebemos e utilizamos o corpo no dia a dia.

uma-melhor-postura.title: A Better Posture
uma-melhor-postura.shortDescription: What if you could improve your posture without trying to "fix" your body?\nExperience a new relationship with your body, with more support, freedom, and ease to move.
uma-melhor-postura.fullDescription:
Your posture tells a story. It reflects the way you organize your body, the habits you've developed over a lifetime, and how you relate to the environment around you.
More than a position we must hold, posture is a dynamic organization of the body to move, balance, and meet the world. It is present in everything we do and influences our sense of comfort, freedom of movement, support, and well-being.
Our skeleton and musculature have an incredible capacity to support us against gravity while allowing for movement and adaptation. However, over time, we can develop habits that increase the effort needed to stay upright, generating unnecessary tensions and pain.
In the A Better Posture workshop, we will explore simple and gentle movements that help recognize these habits and release accumulated tensions.
As the body discovers new ways to organize itself, it finds more efficient and comfortable support. A better posture emerges naturally, without effort or rigidity, allowing you to move with more freedom and ease.
Less effort to stay upright. More comfort and freedom to move.

aprendendo-a-relaxar.title: Learning to Relax
aprendendo-a-relaxar.shortDescription: What if relaxing wasn't something you have to do?\nDiscover how to release unnecessary tension and create space for more calm and presence.
aprendendo-a-relaxar.fullDescription:
Being relaxed is our natural state. Therefore, relaxing is not something we can do, but rather something we can let happen by releasing tension and effort that are no longer necessary.
When the body feels safe and comfortable, relaxation happens naturally, and we can better perceive our breathing, our movements, and the habits that influence how we relate to our own body.
​
In the Learning to Relax workshop, through gentle, effortless movements connected with the breath, we will create the conditions for the body to slow down and the nervous system to find a state of greater calm and restoration.
Relaxation then becomes much more than a pause. It can be a path to expand awareness, perceive what is happening inside us, and discover new possibilities of being in the world.
More calm on the inside. More presence, confidence, and freedom to meet the outside world.

alongar-respirar-e-meditar.title: Stretch, Breathe and Meditate
alongar-respirar-e-meditar.shortDescription: What happens when the body and mind simply stop?\nLet's prepare the body together, find the breath, and explore a path to meditation.
alongar-respirar-e-meditar.fullDescription:
We are almost always busy with something. But being busy does not necessarily mean being present.
Our body and mind have grown accustomed to movement, action, and constant stimuli. Therefore, simply sitting, being quiet, and being present can be a challenge.
Let's first create conditions for the body to find comfort and stillness.
In the Stretch, Breathe, and Meditate workshop, we will explore gentle movements to release joints and unnecessary tension. We will seek points of support that allow us to sit with more comfort and stability, keeping the spine upright without rigidity.
The breath will be our anchor as the body and mind slow down. Without forcing. Without trying to reach beyond what the body allows, just noticing how the body is in the moment.
Without needing to achieve anything. Without needing to do anything. Just creating space for meditation to happen.

transformando-habitos.title: Transforming Habits
transformando-habitos.shortDescription: Do you choose how you move, or do your habits choose for you?\nRecognize your movement patterns and discover new possibilities to move with more freedom, comfort, and ease.
transformando-habitos.fullDescription:
Much of what we do every day happens automatically. These are habits and movement patterns we've learned throughout life that influence our posture, how we move, and even how we feel.
Habits are important. With them, it is possible to perform tasks without having to relearn how to do them every time. But some patterns that were once useful can over time become limiting, creating tension, discomfort, and unnecessary effort.
In the Transforming Habits workshop, we will recognize these patterns and experience new movement possibilities. By expanding our perception, new paths of movement emerge that were previously unused.
A habit does not simply need to be eliminated. We can transform it, offering the body new options and allowing it to discover easier, more pleasurable, and more efficient ways to move.
More perception. More possibilities. More freedom to choose how to move.

movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.title: Daily Movements to Prevent Stress
movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.shortDescription: What if a few minutes of movement could change the way you go through your day?\nLearn simple movements to release tension, regain balance, and slow down.
movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.fullDescription:
Stress is our body's natural response to situations that require adaptation.
The way our body responds to stress and returns to a state of balance influences our well-being. We can remain for long periods accumulating tension and effort without realizing it. Over time, this can affect our energy, concentration, our sleep, the ability to relax, and our quality of life.
In the Daily Movements to Prevent Stress workshop, we will explore movements that help perceive and release accumulated tension and direct attention to areas of the body we tend to hold tight.
More than just relaxing for a few moments, we will learn simple movements and strategies that can be incorporated into daily life, creating small pauses to interrupt the accumulation of tension and regain balance.
Learning to perceive stress in the body is the first step to learning to respond to it in a different way.

recuperando-o-foco.title: Regaining Focus
recuperando-o-foco.shortDescription: What if regaining focus started with emptying the mind?\nDiscover how relaxation and attention to the body can restore your ability to concentrate.
recuperando-o-foco.fullDescription:
Our focus is being stolen. Notifications, social media, emails, multitasking. We live under a constant avalanche of information that fragments our attention and pulls us away from the present moment.
Faced with this, it is natural to try to regain concentration with more effort: more discipline, more control, more willpower. But the mind is already overwhelmed. Demanding more of it is like trying to empty a full glass by pouring more into it.
The path is the opposite.
To regain the ability to focus, we must first empty ourselves. Release the accumulation of tension, stimuli, and noise that the body and mind carry without realizing it.
In the Regaining Focus workshop, we will use gentle, effortless movements to create an internal space of silence and safety. By directing attention to the body and breath, we allow the nervous system to slow down and the mind to naturally find a state of greater clarity.
It's not about training concentration. It's about creating the conditions for it to restore itself. When the body relaxes and the mind empties, focus re-emerges as a consequence of a state of presence.
Regaining focus is, above all, regaining stillness.

corporate.title: A pause for prevention
corporate.subtitle: When there is space for pause and care, work gains a different quality.
corporate.hook: Biostretch brings movement and body awareness experiences into companies, creating moments of pause, reconnection, and care, integrating well-being into the work routine in a simple, accessible, and profound way.

body.p1: Through practices that combine movement, stretching, breathing, and attention to the body, employees are invited to step out of automatic mode and develop a more conscious relationship with their posture, movements, and well-being.
body.pullQuote: An experience designed for each environment.
body.p2: Every company has its own dynamics. Every team faces different physical and mental challenges throughout the workday. Long hours at the computer, repetitive tasks, many hours standing, pressure for results, and an intense routine can generate wear and accumulated tension that goes unnoticed, until the body sends its signals.
body.p3: That is why Biostretch is always adapted to the characteristics and needs of each organization. The practices are built to offer an inclusive and meaningful experience, respecting different ages, profiles, and fitness levels. It is not workplace gymnastics. It is consciousness in movement.

benefits.intro: Biostretch starts from a simple principle: the body was made to move. By bringing more attention to how we position ourselves, breathe, and move, the practice creates opportunities to develop greater body awareness and incorporate self-care habits that last beyond the workshop.

audience.intro: Biostretch Corporate is designed for organizations that wish to create spaces of guided pause, active listening, and strengthening of physical and emotional well-being within the institutional environment. Especially recommended for:

items.seated: People who spend long periods seated in front of screens
items.standing: Employees who spend many hours standing or in constant movement
items.high_demand: High-demand environments that need moments of pause and reconnection
items.attention: Teams seeking more attention and body awareness
items.wellbeing_culture: Companies wanting to integrate well-being into their culture
items.relationships: Organizations that value relationships and balance at work

workshops_section.p1: Biostretch workshops are designed to provide experiences that go beyond a simple break in the routine. They are moments of reconnection with the body, with the breath, and with the present.
workshops_section.p2: Each session creates a space to slow down, move with more awareness, and renew energy to continue the day with more presence and balance.
workshops_section.p3: Experiences can be delivered as part of quality of life programs, internal weeks, corporate events, team gatherings, and other well-being initiatives.

corporate.closing: Companies are made of people. When there is space for care, for pause, and for balance, better conditions are created for healthier relationships, more present teams, and a truly sustainable work environment.

cta.title: Shall we create an experience for your team?
cta.text: Get in touch to learn about the possibilities of Biostretch workshops and experiences designed for your corporate environment.
